job.job_description:
Backend & AI Developer (Python/FastAPI)




About US

We are an early-stage fintech startup revolutionizing personal finance management through AI-powered insights and smart savings solutions. BachatAI helps users track expenses and gain financial insights through automated transaction processing and intelligent recommendations.




The Role

We're looking for a passionate Backend & AI Developer to design and implement our AI chat feature with agentic capabilities. You'll be the first backend/AI hire and will work directly with the founding team to build an intelligent, context-aware conversational financial assistant.




This isn't just a coding jobyou'll be a key decision-maker in product features, architecture, technical direction, and AI implementation strategy.




What You'll Do

Product Development:

Build AI chat APIs with function calling capabilities for agentic workflows
Develop and maintain RESTful APIs using Python and FastAPI framework
Design and implement backend endpoints for transaction processing, budget management, and user data operations
Integrate LLMs (OpenAI GPT-4/Google Gemini) with backend services
Design context-aware AI systems that personalize responses based on user financial data
Implement streaming responses and multi-turn conversation handling
Build FastAPI middleware for authentication, logging, and error handling
Own the complete backend development lifecycle from architecture to deployment

Technical Leadership:

Make critical decisions on AI model selection, prompt engineering, and optimization
Design scalable FastAPI application architecture with proper routing and dependency injection
Implement robust, scalable, and maintainable code following industry best practices
Design Firestore data models and build repository patterns for data access
Create comprehensive API documentation using OpenAPI/Swagger
Implement API versioning and backward compatibility strategies
Set up CI/CD pipelines and manage cloud deployments (when ready)
Optimize AI performance, token usage, and cost management
Build RESTful endpoints following industry standards and best practices

Collaboration & Growth:

Work closely with the product and frontend teams to deliver seamless user experiences
Build callable AI agent functions
Design and document API contracts for frontend integration
Implement WebSocket connections for real-time chat functionality
Participate in product discussions and contribute ideas beyond just implementation



Must-Have Requirements

Experience:

3+ years of Python development experience
Strong hands-on experience with FastAPI or similar frameworks (Flask, Django)
Proven experience with OpenAI API or Google Gemini (LLM integration)
Experience with LLM function calling and tool use
Strong prompt engineering skills
Proven track record of building and deploying backend applications to production



Technical Skills:

Python & Backend:

FastAPI - Must have production experience
Async/await patterns - Proficiency in asynchronous programming (must be proficient)
Pydantic - Data validation and serialization
RESTful API Integration - Experience designing and consuming backend APIs

AI/ML Integration:

LLM Integration - Hands-on experience with OpenAI or Google Gemini APIs
Function Calling - Building AI agents with tool use capabilities
Prompt Engineering - Context building and optimization
Token Management - Understanding of cost optimization and context window management

Cloud & Infrastructure:

Google Cloud Platform - Cloud Run, Firestore, Secret Manager
Firebase - Authentication and Firestore database
Docker - Containerization and deployment
Serverless Architecture - Understanding of cloud-native applications

General:

Git/Version Control - Professional experience with Git workflows
NoSQL Databases - Experience with Firestore, MongoDB, or DynamoDB
Security Best Practices - API authentication, encryption, secure storage
Structured Logging - Application monitoring and debugging



Good to Have

AI/ML:

Experience with LangChain or LlamaIndex for AI orchestration
Knowledge of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns
Experience with AI agent frameworks (AutoGPT, LangGraph, CrewAI)
Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma)
Experience with fine-tuning LLMs or working with embeddings

Backend:

Experience with Gmail API and OAuth 2.0
Knowledge of encryption (AES-256, RSA)
Experience with batch processing and background jobs
Familiarity with pytest and test-driven development
Experience with API rate limiting and throttling

Cloud & Infrastructure:

Experience with Google Cloud Functions or Cloud Tasks
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Cloud Build)
Experience with monitoring tools (Cloud Logging, Sentry)
Understanding of cost optimization in cloud environments

Domain Knowledge:

Experience in fintech or financial applications
Understanding of personal finance concepts
Experience building data-driven applications
Published technical blog posts or articles on AI/backend topics

Portfolio:

Open-source contributions to AI or backend projects
Portfolio of AI/LLM integration projects
Demonstrable experience building production-grade AI applications
